Dinner in air-conditioning
Aug 2026 • Family
We had an excellent dining experience as Americans visiting the area. You need to choose whether or not you’re gonna do à la carte or buffet. We decided to do à la carte. Appetizers came out before they did the meats which we grilled. We did a meat set. The miso marinade and Yakiniku dare sauces were absolutely delicious. You get green leaf lettuce’s and shiso leaf for free with the meats that you order. Our waitress was super sweet and spoke excellent English. She helped us out with the ordering. She made sure we didn’t order too much. The flavor of the food was really good. The wag you was definitely tasty. The air condition upstairs was also remarkable, considering other restaurants don’t have any. We had an amazing dinner.
